title: Endochain Conditions on Modules and $p$-quasi-Frobenius Rings
summary: Analogous to quasi-Frobenius rings, dual rings, and Johns rings, the classes of $p$-quasi-Frobenius rings, $p$-dual rings, $p$-Johns rings are introduced and used to discuss and settle principal analogues of the Faith-Menal, Faith, and FGF conjectures. A chain symmetry theorem establishes that for quasi-injective semi-projective modules with semiprime endomorphism ring, endonoetherianity and endoartinianity are equivalent and force the endomorphism ring to be semisimple artinian.
